what: The supplied examples in the grading schema, materialized once: four model-author numerical records (512 to 8,192 tokens), two 262,144-token engine-reference records and two prefix-reuse items. Every record keeps its original bytes; each entry names its comparison authority; and two generated-history replay examples cut from the public records.

examples/long_reach/reach-code-262144-pu.authority: identified engine-reference recording (one launch of an SGLang server at the release recipe, values rounded to 6 decimals): engine agreement, not independent model-author truth; the model-author implementation does not fit this length on four B200s

examples/long_reach/reach-prose-262144-p.authority: identified engine-reference recording (one launch of an SGLang server at the release recipe, values rounded to 6 decimals): engine agreement, not independent model-author truth; the model-author implementation does not fit this length on four B200s

examples/prefix/prefix-code-public.json.authority: no recorded values: the continuation's cold (flushed) log-probabilities are compared with its warm (cached-prefix) ones, a self-consistency comparison

examples/prefix/prefix-prose-public.json.authority: no recorded values: the continuation's cold (flushed) log-probabilities are compared with its warm (cached-prefix) ones, a self-consistency comparison

examples/short/code-4416-public.json.authority: model-author implementation (the checkpoint's inference/model.py) at exactly the record's length: independent model-author fidelity

examples/short/math-2304-public.json.authority: model-author implementation (the checkpoint's inference/model.py) at exactly the record's length: independent model-author fidelity

examples/short/prose-8192-public.json.authority: model-author implementation (the checkpoint's inference/model.py) at exactly the record's length: independent model-author fidelity

examples/short/structured-512-public.jso.authority: model-author implementation (the checkpoint's inference/model.py) at exactly the record's length: independent model-author fidelity

examples/replay/fresh.json.authority: no recorded values; token slices of the public records named, each with its input digest; generated_replay.py compares the served generation's own log-probabilities with a cold teacher-forced replay of the same history, a self-consistency comparison

examples/replay/prefix.json.authority: no recorded values; token slices of the public records named, each with its input digest; generated_replay.py compares the served generation's own log-probabilities with a cold teacher-forced replay of the same history, a self-consistency comparison
